questionText: The principle of column chromatography is based on the ability of the constituents to

options.A: react with the solvent in the column
options.B: react with each other in the column
options.C: dissolve with each other in the column
options.D: move at different speeds in the column

explanation: Column chromatography separates substances based on different constituent speeds through the column.

questionText: How many lone pairs of electrons are there on the central atom of \(\text{H}_2\text{O}\)?
explanation: The oxygen atom in water has two lone pairs of electrons.

questionText: What volume of oxygen is present in \(150\,\text{cm}^3\) of air at \(27^\circ\text{C}\)? (Air contains 21% oxygen)
How many atoms are in \(0.8\,\text{g}\) of oxygen molecule? \([N_A=6.02\times10^{23}\,\text{mol}^{-1},\;M(\text{O}_2)=32\,\text{g}]\)
On which of the following is the solubility of a gaseous substance dependent? i. Nature of solvent  ii. Nature of solute  iii. Temperature  iv. Pressure
explanation: Solubility of a gas depends on nature of solvent, temperature and pressure — not the nature of the solute.

questionText: \(22.5\,\text{g}\) of \(\text{Pb(NO}_3)_2\) is dissolved in \(25\,\text{g}\) of water at \(20^\circ\text{C}\). Find the solubility in \(\text{mol\,dm}^{-3}\). \([\text{Pb}=207,\text{N}=14,\text{O}=16]\)
Which sample reacts fastest with dilute \(\text{HCl}\)?
explanation: Powdered form has greater surface area; higher temperature increases rate — both favour faster reaction.

questionText: Which equation shows a reaction is in equilibrium?
explanation: A reaction is at equilibrium when \(\Delta G=0\).
Mn goes from \(+7\) to \(+2\), a gain of 5 electrons, so \(x=5\).

questionText: How many Faradays are required to produce \(0.25\,\text{mol}\) of copper? \([\text{Cu}^{2+}]\)
The constituents of air necessary in the rusting process are
explanation: Rusting requires both oxygen (\(\text{O}_2\)) and water (\(\text{H}_2\text{O}\)).

questionText: The salt formed from a strong acid and a strong base is
explanation: A salt from a strong acid and strong base is neutral.

questionText: Given the compound \(\text{CH}_3(\text{CH}_2)_3\text{CH}(\text{C}_3\text{H}_7)\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\), what is its IUPAC name?
explanation: Based on the longest carbon chain and position of the ethyl substituent, the compound is 4-ethyloctane.

questionText: The process that converts ethanol to ethanoic acid is
explanation: Oxidation of ethanol (\(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{OH}\)) produces ethanoic acid (\(\text{CH}_3\text{COOH}\)).

questionText: An example of an oxidation-reduction enzyme is
explanation: Dehydrogenase is a redox enzyme; amylase, protase, and lipase are hydrolytic enzymes.
